NOTIFICATION
In continuation of this office Notification vide Memo No. 204/XI-17/DH&FWS/GTA-2023-27 dated
13.10.2026, inviting applications from bonafide candidates residing in the G.T.A. areas (Darjeeling and
Kalimpong Districts) for admission to the Two Years Diploma Course in Pharmacy at the Institute of
Pharmacy, Jalpaiguri, for the academic session 2026–2027, against 4 (four) reserved seats for GTA-nominated
candidates, it is hereby notified that the last date for submission of duly filled-in applications along with all
requisite supporting documents, which was earlier fixed on 31.10.2026, is hereby extended up to 13.11.2026.
All other terms and conditions, eligibility criteria and instructions as stipulated in the original notification shall
remain unchanged.
Eligible candidates who have not yet submitted their applications are advised to submit the same within the
extended period to the office of the Executive Director, Health & Family Welfare Department, DPMU Section,
2nd Floor, Lewis Jubilee Complex, R.N. Sinha Road, Darjeeling.
No application shall be entertained after the extended date.
Executive Director,
Department of Health & FW,
G.T.A
